name: wiki-mcp-api
description: MCP server per la wiki di dominio LLM Wiki

scripts.build: tsup src/stdio.ts src/http.ts --format esm --no-splitting --dts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/stdio.js';fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));" && chmod +x dist/stdio.js
